# Project Context: report-clarity

<!-- Auto-generated by /cortex-spec from spec artifacts. -->

## Tech Stack

No code dependencies. All changes are to markdown files (templates and skill instruction files).

## Conventions

- Skill files: `skills/*/SKILL.md` in repo — hard-linked to `~/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md`. One edit updates both.
- Template files: `templates/cortex/*.md` — read by skills at runtime.
- Section headers in skill files use `### Phase N:` convention.
- Template placeholder convention: `{FIELD_NAME}` in ALL_CAPS.

## Architecture Rules

- Additive only: new content is added, existing content is preserved unchanged below it.
- Necessity filter applies to all owner-facing summary sections: "cut any sentence that doesn't help the owner decide or act right now."
- No file paths, timestamps, or artifact references in the Owner Summary layer.
- Two-layer structure: Owner layer (plain English, scannable) above a visual separator; Detail layer (existing content) below.

## Write Boundaries

- `templates/cortex/research-dossier.md`
- `templates/cortex/spec.md`
- `skills/cortex-research/SKILL.md`
- `skills/cortex-spec/SKILL.md`
- `skills/cortex-drive/SKILL.md`
